name: Influence Origin
summary: L4 defines the origin point of unseen directional influence. It is the proto-source of gradient formation and the first anchor of gradientIntensity within the S3 Spine.

description.canonical: L4 establishes the origin of unseen directional influence. It is the dimensional anchor from which gradientIntensity emerges and the first structural foothold of the gradient node in the S3 Spine.
description.cosmology: In the cosmology chain, L4 represents the proto-origin of directional bias emerging from continuity mechanics. It is the earliest precursor to force-regime directionality.
description.spine: Within the S3 Spine, L4 is the foundational dimension of the gradient node, defining the initial point from which influence direction is shaped.
description.mcp: In MCP operations, L4 is used to initialize gradient-state mechanics, providing the origin coordinate for influence modeling.

ai.purpose: Defines the origin of unseen directional influence for AI reasoning and MCP gradient initialization.
